entities.summary: Leader of Norway (1905–1957 (King)). Danish Prince Carl, chosen by referendum; first modern Norwegian king; WWII exile (refused Nazi collaboration, broadcast from London, 'NEI' to Quisling demand); national symbol of resistance; returned
